ORDINANCE Ss

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance is amended by changing all of the B1-1,
Neighborhood Shopping District symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 16-L in
the area bound by:

a line 55.25 feet north of and parallel to West 64" Street; the alley next west of and
parallel to South Central Avenue; West 64" Street; and South Central Avenue,

to those of a RS2, Residential Single-Unit (Detached House) District.
SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.

Marty Quiyin (/
Alderman, 13‘ Ward

Common Address:
6355 S. Central Avenue
